front.title: A SCITT Profile for Verifiable Audit Trails in Algorithmic Trading: The VeritasChain Protocol (VCP)

abstract.t: This document defines a profile of the SCITT (Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust) architecture for creating tamper-evident audit trails of AI-driven algorithmic trading decisions and executions. The VeritasChain Protocol (VCP) applies the SCITT framework to address the specific requirements of financial markets, including high-precision timestamps, considerations arising from recordkeeping regimes such as the EU AI Act and MiFID II, and a crypto-shredding mechanism intended to support erasure obligations such as those under the GDPR. This profile specifies how VCP events are encoded as SCITT Signed Statements, registered with Transparency Services, and verified using COSE Receipts. It further defines SCITT conformance profiles for interoperability and an ERASURE event type that records crypto-shredding operations as append-only audit events. The profile makes trading records auditable and attributable after the fact; it does not prevent or block any trading activity, and it does not warrant the correctness of any recorded decision.
